What SUP Baltic Sea?Considered a hidden gem for many years, the Baltic Sea is now a retreat for water sports practitioners. People from different parts of the world and cultures join the mesmerising background of the Baltic Sea to practice surfing, sailing and most importantly of all, SUP!

programmes.t: Inside Vienna: Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports
programmes.d: Welcome to Vienna!Austria’s capital, lying by the Danube River and known for its artistic and intellectual legacy shaped by residents as Mozart, Beethoven or Sigmund Freud amongst others.
Andi is back in the Watamu Marine Reserve but this time on a new mission: save the endangered sea turtles. She spends three days at the Local Ocean Trust with Marine Biologist Casper van de Geer.

Welcome back sailors! Today we are indulging in the most fragrant gardens of the islands of Cres and Losinj where the beauty of nature is next level. These islands are also known as the favourite place for many boaters who like to enjoy beautiful beaches and top restaurants. Let's dive in.

It's a new year, so what kind of resolutions have the America's Cup athletes made? And what's the local hangover cure for too much Bermudan rum? Find out in episode 3 of Road to Bermuda!

programmes.t: The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl
programmes.d: Andi van Zyl is in Ios Island at the time the Meltemi winds start, and she is ready to enjoy watersports both above and below the surface.

In this year's season of Kite Maters we follow the life of Toni Vodisek, an athlete that has everything needed to become a star and win multiple titles. He has already won three World Series events in a row and found himself close to the podium spots at the end of the year.

We follow one of the most recognizable figures in the kite family: Florian Gruber. We’ll hear the story from the man behind the successful transformation of kiteboarding; from a bevy of kiteboarders spending their free time casually competing, to an Olympic Sailing Class.
